Flip a coin. If heads, each Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

ru: You can't have more than 1 Pokémon Star in your deck.

name: Metagross ★

atk.x: Count the number of Prize cards your opponent has taken. Search your discard pile for up to that many Metal Energy cards and attach them to Metagross Star.
Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

ru: You can't have more than 1 Pokémon Star in your deck.

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
